name: Louisiana
agency: Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries (LDWF)

rule.textEn: Anyone born after Jan. 1, 1984 needs an LDWF-approved boater education course to run a motorboat over 10 hp (or a qualified adult over 18 on board) and always to run a PWC.
rule.textEs: Quien nació después del 1 de enero de 1984 necesita un curso aprobado por LDWF para manejar una lancha de más de 10 hp (o un adulto habilitado mayor de 18 a bordo) y siempre para una moto acuática.

minAge.note: PWC operators must be 16 or older.

exemptions: Accompanied by someone over 18 who completed an approved course (not for PWC).

card.feeNote: LDWF classroom course is free; the BoatUS online course is free; a free boater education endorsement can be added to the driver license at renewal.

rental: Renters (18+) of boats over 10 hp from a state-approved livery watch a safety video that gives a 48-hour exemption.

sources.publisher: Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries
sources.quote: if you were born after January 1, 1984, you must successfully complete an LDWF-approved boater education course to operate a motorboat over 10 horsepower, unless you are accompanied by someone over age 18 who has a successfully completed an LDWF-approved boater education course

sources.publisher: Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries
sources.quote: You must also be age 16 or older to operate a personal watercraft.

sources.publisher: Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries
sources.quote: LDWF offers a free, in-person boater education course that satisfies boater education requirements.

sources.publisher: Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries
sources.quote: After watching this rental boating safety and education video, individuals have a 48-hour exemption to operate a rented vessel from a state-approved livery.
